sourceOfTruth.rule: Use the client source for DbContext overrides and installed NGO.Core.Repositories.dll for inherited contract changes.

knownBreakingChanges.rule: Inspect SaveChanges-related overrides and audit compression helpers before patching.

antiPatterns: Do not regenerate migrations before the build succeeds.
Do not manually edit EF model snapshot unless the EF command produced a verified change.

commands: dotnet ef migrations add UpgradeCore{major}x --context NgoContext --project <migrations-project>
successCriteria: EF migration command succeeds or reports no changes detected.
